fusions.name: Murder Stroke
fusions.desc: A hilt strike that deals 14 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Gap in the Gorget
fusions.desc: A thrust between the plates that deals 24 damage, ignores armour and makes the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Gatehouse Bulwark
fusions.desc: Raises a guard that absorbs the next 22 damage, up to 4 blows, and holds for 6 seconds. Your armour rises by 8% while you carry it.

fusions.name: Fencer's Harness
fusions.desc: Conjures fitted plate: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, your attack speed rises by 4%, and 8% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
